description: Set the hiring progress of a submitted application. Values: NO_RESPONSE no response / SCREENING_PASSED passed screening / ASSESSMENT_PENDING assessment pending / ASSESSMENT_DONE assessment done / WRITTEN_TEST written test (taken or not) / WRITTEN_TEST_DONE written test done / INTERVIEW interview (round unspecified) / INTERVIEW_AI AI interview / INTERVIEW_FIRST 1st round interview / INTERVIEW_SECOND 2nd round interview / INTERVIEW_THIRD 3rd round interview / INTERVIEW_FINAL final interview / INTERVIEW_HR HR interview / OC verbal offer / OFFER offer / REJECTED rejected / WITHDRAWN withdrawn by the user / CUSTOM custom (the user-named stage is in custom). When no preset fits, use CUSTOM and put the stage name as the user said it in custom. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope job_applications:write.)

applicationId.description: Application id, from list_job_applications or the reply of an add-to-list tool

name: update_job_application_progress
